quick: 4 to 5 drops into the affected ear two to three times daily
summary: Paradichlorobenzene 2% is the wax-dissolving component of Indian ear drops that also contain chlorbutol, benzocaine and turpentine oil.
indications: Softening and removal of impacted ear wax

dosage.d: 4 to 5 drops into the affected ear two to three times daily

admin: Use only as the finished product directs
moa: Organic solvent that softens and disperses cerumen.

absolute: Perforated tympanic membrane, grommets, ear surgery

preg: Safety not established; use only if clearly needed
lact: Safety not established; weigh benefit against unknown risk
counsel: Use exactly as the pack directs
Stop and seek care for rash, swelling or breathing difficulty
missed: Take it when remembered unless the next dose is due; do not double up.
overdose: If swallowed in quantity: supportive care; it is hepatotoxic and nephrotoxic at high systemic doses.
refs: Martindale: The Complete Drug Reference (Pharmaceutical Press)
